notes.claim: REQ-01-018 falls back to Organization.countryCode for a member who states no country, and the README presents that chain as the one time-off already owns. PATCH-012 removed that fallback from the product and the code holds no such chain, so the portal would answer a different country than every other screen for the same member.

witness.detail: specs/portal/README.md §Related Areas: 'specs/time-off/ — owns the country-resolution chain the holidays block uses: a country stated on the membership, falling back to Organization.countryCode. REQ-01-018 states that chain in full rather than pointing at it.' specs/patches/PATCH-012-a-member-states-their-own-country-or-none.md §The rule: 'THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve a member's holiday country from the country stated on their own membership, and from nothing else' and 'THE SYSTEM SHALL pay a member with no resolved country the global holidays only — the rows carrying no country — in the Holidays summary, in the time-off calendar, in the holiday list read as mine, and in Amounts Owed.' The code agrees with the patch: packages/validation/src/reports.ts:566-573 (`resolveMemberHolidayCountry` reads only `membershipCountry` and returns null when it is blank) and apps/api/src/holidays/holidays.service.ts:111-118 ('PATCH-012 — the caller's own stated country. A caller who states none sees the global rows only, rather than the ones the organization's country would have lent them'). Scenario: an organization with countryCode 'US' and a member whose membership states none, with one US holiday and one global holiday seeded. GET .../holidays?scope=mine answers the global holiday alone; GET .../portal/home under REQ-01-018 answers both, and TC-01-INT-07 asserts it must.

notes.suggestedFix: Either drop the third link — REQ-01-018 resolves the membership's country and nothing else, REQ-01-019 becomes 'a member who states no country', TC-01-INT-07's second leg changes — or state deliberately, in this spec's own text, that the portal reinstates the organization fallback that PATCH-012 removed and why one screen may answer a different country than the calendar and the payroll report do. The README's Related Areas sentence is false either way and must go.
